scripts.format: npm run format-java && npm run format-xml
scripts.format-changed: npm run format-java-changed && npm run format-xml-changed
scripts.format-xml-changed: prettier --plugin=@prettier/plugin-xml --tab-width 4 --xml-whitespace-sensitivity preserve --write $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep '\.xml$' | sed 's|^backend/||' | xargs)
